news.title: ICON Lab showcases crane lift simulator at Monash Open Day 2026
news.excerpt: ICON Lab demonstrated its high-fidelity crane lift simulator at Monash Clayton Open Day, engaging prospective students with immersive construction research.

news.title: Dr Yihai Fang, promoted to Associate Professor
news.excerpt: A/Prof Yihai Fang has been promoted to Associate Professor at Monash University in the latest academic promotion round.

news.title: ICON Research Lab Presents Four Papers at ISARC 2026 in Singapore
news.excerpt: ICON Research Lab presented four papers at ISARC 2026 in Singapore on construction robotics, human–robot collaboration, and intelligent task planning.

news.title: Leo wins the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering 'Best TA Award'
news.excerpt: Leo Yu was recognised with the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering Best Teaching Assistant Award.

news.title: ICON Lab's crane lift simulator draws strong interest at the Faculty of Engineering Specialisation Selection Showcase Event
news.excerpt: ICON Lab presented its crane lift simulator at the Faculty of Engineering Specialisation Selection Showcase Event.

news.title: Junlin Wang Wins AI Competition Award
news.excerpt: Junlin places 2nd in the Regional Final of the WorldQuant International Quant Championship 2025 and represents Australia at the Global Final.

news.title: Pavement roughness monitoring research featured in ABC interview and 7 News
news.excerpt: ICON Lab pavement roughness monitoring research was featured in an ABC Conversation Hour interview and a 7 News report.

news.title: ICON Lab wins the 2025 Construction Innovation Award (International Merit) from the Hong Kong Construction Industry Council (CIC)
news.excerpt: Songbo Hu received the International Merit award in Hong Kong on behalf of ICON Lab.

news.title: Yihai Fang Receives Outstanding Supervision Award
news.excerpt: Yihai receives the 2025 Outstanding Supervision Award from the Monash Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering.

news.title: The Monash-TUM collaboration wins the "Best Paper Award" at the 2024 EC3 conference
news.excerpt: A Monash–TUM collaboration received the EC3 Best Paper Award for work on knowledge graph-enhanced computer vision for concrete pouring monitoring.

news.title: Yihai Fang Receives Award for Excellence in Research
news.excerpt: Yihai receives the 2024 Award for Excellence in Research from the Monash Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering.
